# Tools

Every tool name the shipped toolsets refer to, and every shipped toolset. Pages name a tool by linking to its entry here, for example `` [`todo`](../reference/tools.md#todo) ``; `cargo xtask gen` refuses a link to a name that is not listed or whose text differs from its target, so documentation and the tool registry cannot name a tool differently. `prometheus toolsets show <name>` prints what a toolset resolves to in a profile, with each tool's availability.
